scope: Curated bibliography and credit map. Not an exhaustive bibliography of every historical working file; source-specific references in archived notes remain necessary.

references.authors: Vaughan F. R. Jones
references.title: A polynomial invariant for knots via von Neumann algebras
references.role: Foundational invariant and component-count specialization; not a project result.

references.authors: Louis H. Kauffman
references.title: State models and the Jones polynomial
references.role: Bracket state sum and skein calculus underlying the exact certificates.

references.authors: W. B. R. Lickorish and Kenneth C. Millett
references.title: Some evaluations of link polynomials
references.role: Theorems 1 and 3 supply the Arf and sixth-root evaluations; Theorem 1 credits H. Murakami.

references.authors: Shalom Eliahou, Louis H. Kauffman and Morwen Thistlethwaite
references.title: Infinite families of links with trivial Jones polynomial
references.role: Hopf-shell construction, Omega operation, and actual Jones-trivial links; preserve component/framing conventions.

references.authors: Shalom Eliahou and Jean Fromentin
references.title: A remarkable 20-crossing tangle
references.role: Definitions 3.1–3.2, Lemma 4.2, Proposition 5.2: source of the modular family and the seed used for the project’s depth-four deduction.

references.authors: Abhijit Champanerkar and Ilya Kofman
references.title: On links with cyclotomic Jones polynomials
references.role: Multivariable twist-bracket framework; Proposition 2.1 is the prior expansion behind fixed-template calculations.

references.authors: Adam S. Sikora
references.title: Tangle equations, the Jones conjecture, slopes of surfaces in tangle complements, and q-deformed rationals
references.role: V2 Proposition 1, Conjecture 2, Theorems 3 and 21, Corollary 20. The project’s objection to Proposition 10(1) is separate from its candidate proof.

references.authors: Jacob Rasmussen and Sarah Dean Rasmussen
references.title: Floer simple manifolds and L-space intervals
references.role: Propositions 1.3–1.4, torsion normal form, Corollary 2.3, Definition 7.2 and Proposition 7.8 in the pinned version.

references.authors: Fyodor Gainullin
references.title: Heegaard Floer homology and knots determined by their complements
references.role: Theorem 8.2: methodological antecedent for surgery comparison, Alexander derivative and L-space structure.

references.authors: Yi Ni and Zhongtao Wu
references.title: Cosmetic surgeries on knots in S3
references.role: Proposition 3.1: the exact Casson–Walker surgery formula used in the manuscript.

references.authors: Steven Boyer and Daniel Lines
references.title: Surgery formulae for Casson’s invariant and extensions to homology lens spaces
references.role: Antecedent for the formula cited in the explicit Ni–Wu restatement; no unchecked original theorem number is asserted.

references.authors: Dorothy Buck and Mauro Maximo Mauricio
references.title: Connect sum of lens spaces surgeries: application to Hin recombination
references.publication: Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 150 (2011), 505–525; arXiv:1007.0948
references.role: Preprint title differs: Tangle solutions for composite knots: applications to Hin recombination. Theorem 3.5(2) supplies the cited form of Lickorish’s criterion.

references.authors: W. B. R. Lickorish
references.title: Prime knots and tangles
references.role: Rational-tangle/solid-torus criterion; project uses the explicit Buck–Mauricio formulation.

references.authors: Claus Ernst and De Witt Sumners
references.title: A calculus for rational tangles: applications to DNA recombination
references.role: Classical rational-tangle calculus. The project’s specific two-probe example is credited instead to the 1999 paper.

references.authors: Claus Ernst and De Witt Sumners
references.title: Solving tangle equations arising in a DNA recombination model
references.role: Example 3: source of the unframed two-probe calibration, after the stated mirror and reparametrization.

references.authors: Kenneth L. Baker and Dorothy Buck
references.title: The classification of rational subtangle replacements between rational tangles
references.role: Prior classification and tangle-rigidity context; not superseded by a scalar bracket argument.

references.authors: Peter Kronheimer, Tomasz Mrowka, Peter Ozsváth and Zoltán Szabó
references.title: Monopoles and lens space surgeries
references.role: Classical unknot-surgery special case; must not be presented as a new project theorem.

references.authors: W. B. R. Lickorish
references.title: An Introduction to Knot Theory
references.role: Chapter 9, Theorems 9.3–9.4 and Corollary 9.5: Goeritz presentation, including determinant-zero situations.

references.authors: Alexander Stoimenow
references.title: Square numbers, spanning trees and invariants of achiral knots
references.role: Proposition 6.5 is used only for the checked odd-determinant/knot consequence.

references.authors: Michael Snape
references.title: Homological invariants of strongly invertible knots
references.role: Sections 2.1.1–2.1.2 and 3.2.2; Theorem 3.3.14; existing Sakuma-link detection question and encircling calculus.

references.authors: Liam Watson
references.title: Khovanov homology and the symmetry group of a knot
references.role: Theorem 1, Definition 10 and Proposition 11: persistent homological invariant; homological detection does not imply Euler detection.

references.authors: Artem Kotelskiy, Liam Watson and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: Immersed curves in Khovanov homology
references.role: Curve invariant, gluing and graded algebra; Definition 4.19 and Theorem 4.21 in the pinned source.

references.authors: Artem Kotelskiy, Liam Watson and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: Khovanov homology and strong inversions
references.role: Published inversion table and long-special pairing; longer components were already noted after Conjecture 3.7.

references.authors: Artem Kotelskiy, Liam Watson and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: Khovanov multicurves are linear
references.role: Linearity and whole-object extension. Theorem 4.4 does not automatically split into independent summand extensions.

references.authors: Artem Kotelskiy, Liam Watson and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: On mutation invariance in Khovanov homology
references.role: Definition 3.12 and Theorems 3.17, 3.19: normal forms and geography over fields; the project’s convention dictionary is separate.

references.authors: Artem Kotelskiy, Tye Lidman, Allison H. Moore, Liam Watson and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: Cosmetic operations and Khovanov multicurves
references.role: Theorems 2.6–2.7 and proof of Theorem 1.2: actual unknot-cap structure and split-tangle detection.

references.authors: Lukas Lewark, Laura Marino and Claudius Zibrowius
references.title: Khovanov homology and refined bounds for Gordian distances
references.role: Replacement-map invariants and rational Gordian distance; the project separately studies what those maps cannot detect in formal examples.

references.authors: Robert Lipshitz and Sucharit Sarkar
references.title: Khovanov homology of strongly invertible knots and their quotients
references.role: Theorem 1.1 and Section 3: axis-moving map cone and equivariant spectral sequence. Map-level dictionary remains open in this project.

references.authors: J. Elisenda Grigsby and Stephan Wehrli
references.title: On the Colored Jones Polynomial, Sutured Floer Homology, and Knot Floer Homology
references.role: Proposition 5.20 and Theorem 1.2 are inputs; Proposition 6.9 and Conjecture 7.1 enter the separate conditional grading objection.

references.authors: J. Elisenda Grigsby and Stephan Wehrli
references.title: Khovanov homology, sutured Floer homology, and annular links
references.role: Theorem 1.1 fixes mirror conventions. Do not import the removed converse of the cutting theorem from v1.

references.authors: András Juhász
references.title: Holomorphic discs and sutured manifolds
references.role: Example 2.4 and Proposition 9.2: meridional sutures and knot Floer target.

references.authors: Aliakbar Daemi
references.title: Abelian Gauge Theory, Knots and Odd Khovanov Homology
references.role: Theorems 2, 3, 4.9 and Section 1.4: plane-Floer filtered complex underlying MATCH.

references.authors: Peter B. Kronheimer and Tomasz S. Mrowka
references.title: Khovanov homology is an unknot-detector
references.role: Reduced Khovanov rank-one detection; Euler characteristic alone is weaker.

references.authors: Mikami Hirasawa, Ryota Hiura and Makoto Sakuma
references.title: The equivariant genera of marked strongly invertible knots associated with 2-bridge knots
references.role: Proposition 2.2 supplies the scope distinction between side-preserving and side-exchanging inversions.

references.authors: Stephen Bigelow
references.title: Representations of braid groups
references.publication: Proceedings of the ICM, Beijing 2002, vol. 2, 37–46; arXiv:math/0304212
references.role: Homological representations and pairings: background, not justification for an unproved specialization-faithfulness inference.

references.authors: Louis Funar and Toshitake Kohno
references.title: On Burau representations at roots of unity
references.role: Section 3, particularly Proposition 3.5 and Lemma 3.4 on the odd sequence, in finite-index pattern arguments.

references.authors: Vaughan F. R. Jones and Sarah A. Reznikoff
references.title: Hilbert space representations of the annular Temperley–Lieb algebra
references.role: Section 2, Theorem 2.1 and preceding discussion: positive unitary specialization used in the TRUSTED constant-braid restriction.

references.authors: Michael H. Freedman, Michael J. Larsen and Zhenghan Wang
references.title: A modular functor which is universal for quantum computation
references.role: Equations (14)–(15) for a unitary path model; no generic exact-gate universality is inferred.

references.authors: Vasudha Bharathram, Joan S. Birman and Tara E. Brendle
references.title: The Burau representation is faithful for n = 4
references.role: Version-specific preparation/parity/count package discussed in HUMAN_WORK_AND_CORRECTIONS; no nonfaithfulness conclusion.

references.authors: Avishy Carmi and Eliahu Cohen
references.title: On trivial Jones–Vassiliev polynomials
references.role: Proposition 5.12, Theorem 5.6 and Lemma 5.8: joint universal residual package challenged by the project’s explicit family.

references.authors: Joel Hass, Jeffrey C. Lagarias and Nicholas Pippenger
references.title: The Computational Complexity of Knot and Link Problems
references.role: Theorem 1.1: unknot recognition in NP; hypothesis for conditional Jones-triviality complexity statements.

references.authors: Marc Lackenby
references.title: The efficient certification of knottedness and Thurston norm
references.role: Theorem 1.1: knottedness in NP; no GRH assumption is needed for this input.

references.authors: Greg Kuperberg
references.title: How Hard Is It to Approximate the Jones Polynomial?
references.role: Theorem 1.2 concerns promised root-value distinctions and Cook–Turing hardness, not exact full-polynomial many-one JT2 hardness.

references.authors: Pawel Wocjan and Jon Yard
references.title: The Jones polynomial: quantum algorithms and applications in quantum complexity theory
references.role: Theorems 8.3–8.4 concern bits of normalized root evaluations, not the full unit fibre.
